UserPreferencesDoc.title: UserPreferencesDoc
UserPreferencesDoc.description: Cloud-saved user preferences and persistent favorite drivers and constructors for cross-device synchronization.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name or paddock callsign.

favoriteDrivers.description: List of canonical driver IDs favorited by the user (max 25).

favoriteTeams.description: List of canonical constructor IDs favorited by the user (max 15).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user document storing cloud-synced F1 Hub favorites and preferences, keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
